dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible on the mid-lateral flank are several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped annular structures with sharp gradient transitions from a dark charcoal exterior to a pale grey interior. The edge geometry is predominantly curvilinear with high-contrast, well-defined perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of irregular, high-intensity light grey pixel clusters is concentrated on the neck and anterior dorsal region. These clusters transition from tightly packed, interlocking geometries in the mid-section to smaller, more discrete and isolated points towards the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three distinct macro-annuli on the lower-mid flank form a clear scalene triangle relationship. A secondary linear alignment of four high-intensity blobs is visible following the curve of the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pelage exhibits a complex, interconnected reticulated pattern where light-colored lines form a honeycomb-like lattice, particularly prominent in the transition zone between the dorsal and lateral regions.
